battle_phases.start_condition: Both eastern restraints are cleared and western clearers can be funded.
survival_dependencies: Midnight must survive the complete officer pair, not merely its first block.
Civilian HP must tolerate any approach attacks until safe passage; operator blocking does not restrain civilians.

survival_dependencies: Robot delays use ordinary HP and blocking only; their exact lifetimes are unverified.

battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Surviving artillery, a central defender collapse or a leak invalidates the plan; later skills cannot retroactively repair the loss.

survival_dependencies: Steward can receive Beagle-centered splash and requires real treatment.
Both defenders absorb armor damage using their HP reserves while healing also sustains the caster.
Medical recipient selection and ground-target contention remain material uncertainties.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward contributes during the initial lower crossing. Steward, Durin, Midnight and GALLUS own final western artillery clearance. Temporary candidates and Beagle manage operator exposure; actual death must be observed.

Melantha clears eastern lower restraint; Popukar directly clears western lower restraint. Preserve an unobstructed civilian exit and confirm safe arrival.
Fang hands upper central containment to Beagle. Friston temporarily intercepts the first armor. Steward and Durin clear the remaining queue under western treatment.
Vanilla hands lower central containment to Spot. CONFESS temporarily intercepts the first armor. Steward supplies arts; Hibiscus owns ordinary Spot treatment.
Plume handles the opening. Midnight remains the permanent western interceptor. Kormaru and Castle delay the first final-wave officer so Midnight can attack artillery.
Melantha handles the opening, Popukar clears the western restraint and first pair, and Cardigan contains subsequent officers without assumed self-healing.

formation_structure.artillery_geometry: Both permanent medics are three rows from the artillery's upper horizontal return and remain outside its two-tile acquisition radius there. Beagle [3,3] is diagonally separated from Durin [2,2], and separated from Spot [4,4] and Midnight [1,3] beyond the 1.2 splash radius. Steward [2,3] is inside Beagle-centered splash and therefore explicitly receives joint medical support.
formation_structure.capacity: At most eight rarity-2/3 operators are deployed. The inspected runtime exempts rarity-1 operators from that counter. Popukar leaves before Cardigan enters; Fang leaves before Beagle enters; Lancet leaves before GALLUS uses her tile.
formation_structure.clearance_limit: The final artillery window is a damage hypothesis, not a proved total. Armor contention, officer interception and medical recipient selection can consume its margin.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP and natural 1 DP/s. Credit Fang grants at 570, 1320, 2070 and 2820, and Vanilla activations at 750 and 1650 only while their survival conditions hold.
economy.conditional_living_refunds: Ansel 8, Melantha 7, Vanilla 5, Plume 5, Fang 5, Popukar 9 and Lancet 1.
economy.excluded_income: No robot death refunds, kill DP, unsupported talents or later Fang/Vanilla grants.
economy.failure_interpretation: A missing survival-dependent grant or living refund invalidates its handoff; it is not an arithmetic correction.
economy.redeployment: Ansel retreats at 1830 and returns at 4200, exceeding the 70-second cooldown. The inspected public runtime charges the source deployment cost of 17 again; client redeployment pricing is not inferred.
economy.static_check: A read-only conditional ledger has no negative entries, minimum balance 0 DP and 19 DP remaining at frame 4980.

formation_structure.permanent_structure: Beagle holds upper central, Spot holds lower central, Midnight holds upper outer, and Cardigan holds lower outer. Steward covers both central defender tiles; Durin supplements upper central. Both permanent medics occupy the western lower high ground.
formation_structure.selection_dependency: The inspected current simulator promotes neutral candidates, then uses operator_id among eligible operator candidates. Beagle precedes Steward and the temporary robots; Kormaru precedes GALLUS. Acquisition geometry still determines eligibility. These are current-model dependencies, not client target-order claims.
verified_range_geometry: Lancet UP [2,5] covers both opening vanguards.
Opening Ansel LEFT [5,5] covers Vanilla and Melantha, but does not cover Fang.
Hibiscus DOWN [5,3] covers Beagle, Spot, Steward, Durin and permanent Ansel.
Permanent Ansel DOWN [5,2] covers Beagle, Steward, Durin and Hibiscus; ordinary range misses Spot.
Ansel's active forward extension reaches Midnight [1,3].
Midnight UP [1,3] reaches western upper roadblock [1,2] and artillery cells [2,2], [2,3] and [2,4].

formation_transitions.transition: Ansel treats the lower opening while Lancet continues Fang's treatment.
Withdraw Ansel before the artillery's eastern lower approach; retain Lancet through the medical gap.
Replace Vanilla's forward interception with Spot's western three-block position and install Hibiscus.

Withdraw Lancet after the permanent medical formation is established.
GALLUS enters after Kormaru establishes the temporary eastern acquisition candidate.
Joint medical skills, Beagle's defense and Midnight's arts support the final artillery window.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator must have catalog rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true. Deploy only on the declared legal terrain; never on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Lancet must actually heal the central opening. The altered Ansel facing leaves Fang dependent on Lancet until the western handoff; prior survival is not automatically inherited.
Credit refunds only from successful living retreats. Each western successor must enter before a released enemy passes its interception tile.
Midnight must survive both route-17 officers and retain interception through clearance. Temporary front blockers supplement this duty.
Observe all four DEVICE_DESTROYED events and two PROTECTED_TARGET_REACHED events. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians; roadblock delay is not protection.

Both permanent medics and both central defenders must enter the artillery burst alive with usable HP reserves. Account for Steward receiving Beagle-centered splash and for armor simultaneously damaging the defenders.
Robot deaths may satisfy their delay duties, but yield no refund. No later action assumes those robots remain deployed.
Require actual artillery death before western escape. Do not replace target contention with an unconditional sum of theoretical DPS.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and both expected protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Preserve the demonstrated runner interceptions, maintain real central healing, clear eastern restraints and withdraw exposed Ansel alive.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Lost opening containment or income invalidates later deployments.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Directly clear both western restraints, maintain Midnight's interception through both route-17 officers, and establish both civilian arrivals.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Restraint alone leaves civilians exposed to officers and the returning artillery.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Charge both medics, delay armor and the upper outer officer, mitigate Beagle-centered splash and kill artillery before its western escape.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: An artillery survivor or a medical collapse rejects the clearance hypothesis.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Restore normal central damage allocation and maintain all four interceptions through the final spawns.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A delayed armor queue can exceed blocking capacity.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Finish every remaining hostile under sustained treatment and verify both protected arrivals.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Spawn exhaustion alone does not establish acceptance.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic income only until the living retreat at frame 3000.
Supported opening income and ATK; no later income assumed.
Accelerate the first lower outer officer pair before Cardigan's handoff.
Reduce physical artillery splash during the western burst, then reinforce later containment. This does not mitigate armor arts attacks.
Hold the first skill for artillery arts conversion and subsequent officers; do not spend it on earlier clearance.
Strengthen treatment during the artillery burst and later armor clearance.
Strengthen joint treatment and extend coverage to Midnight; each repeat includes active duration and inactive SP recovery.
Credit ordinary supported stats and blocking only where applicable. No healing mode, self-heal, damage reduction, sleep, extra DP, deployment slashes, fear, buffs or resistance reduction.

tactical_thesis: Preserve the four opening interceptions and Lancet's effective central coverage, then move permanent treatment and interception west. Clear both western roadblocks directly, sustain Midnight through repeated officers, and reserve a supported medical and defense burst for western artillery clearance. Temporary blockers separate armored arrivals and an outer officer from that damage window. This is an unexecuted full-stage hypothesis; artillery damage closure remains unverified.
